title: Reputation Snap
tagline: Cryptarot analyzes your existing crypto portfolio alongside tarot readings to give you (not) an investment advice with a comparable accuracy to technical analysis. Powered by AI.
description:
Embrace the magic of unprecedented volatility.
Introducing cryptarot, a groundbreaking application that combines the power of crypto trading with the ancient art of tarot reading to provide personalized (not) investment advice. Users can explore unconventional yet intriguing investment strategies while gaining a deeper understanding of their portfolio's potential trajectory. Embrace the mystical and modern world of finance with Cryptarot, where the wisdom of blockchain meets the mysticism of tarot for a truly unique investing experience.

Why should you use cryptarot vs. research & analytics?
Tell me why you shouldn't? The market is broken anyway.

How does it work? Magically simple.
1. Connect your wallet to Cryptarot to unleash the magic.
2. Get an aggregated dashboard of your crypto portfolio.
3. Spread the tarot to get 6 cards that perfectly describe your destiny and financial future.
4. Get an ultra-personalized (not) investment advice from cryptarot's AI-stuffed backend witch.
5. ???
6. Profit (flex your two-digit X in front of your technical analysis bro).

Cryptarot brings a breath of fresh air to crypto trading by allowing you to rebalance your portfolio in an easy and playful way.
how_its_made:
Users can interact with our app using WalletConnect or Metamask or Coinbase Wallet as a wallet connector.

Users can connect their Metamask, Coinbase Wallet, and any wallets accessible via WalletConnect. When the wallet connects, we collect tokens and their balances data on Polygon PoS using Moralis' API. Then it spreads the tarot cards and sends an API call to GPT 3.5 with a predefined prompt. As a result, the frontend displays the tarot reading and (not) investment advice relevant to the wallet's crypto portfolio. Then the user has the option to spread the tarot cards again to get an alternative advice.
